_about: Test poses for scripts/real/precision_check.py (motor frame, rad). right_work = the right arm's hand pose at the hand-over of the seated run full_155211_align_full2 (2026-11-03), raised 40 mm with the same orientation (IK on i2rt's yam model) so the default 40 mm table clearance holds with the PC off the table. Loading on joints 2-5 is close to the working pose. right_test: the default test pose since 2026-11-06 (see right_test_source).

right_test_source.why: right_work and its steps are 76.7 mm from the measured left arm at rest (2026-11-06), under the 80 mm limit; this visited gravity pose has the gravity load (joints 2-5) closest to right_work and keeps 130 mm from the left arm at rest, its limp variations and its measured pose, steps included.
